two-finger scroll = pan · pinch (or ctrl/cmd+scroll) = zoom · drag = pan.
click node = focus its neighborhood · shift/⌘-click (or long-press) = pin: the graph stays full so you can pin a second node; two or more pins show only what connects to all of them · space = expand one hop · shift+space = retract · esc/click bg = reset · click edge = relationship details.
dashed edge = relationship through one hidden node · fit includes peripheral and disconnected satellites.
